paper.title: Efficacy of Penicillin-Streptomycin as a Repellent on Chemotaxis Behavior of Escherichia coli
paper.readout: 10x live microscopy (trackpy) + Tecan M200 OD600 spatial reads

ROBOT: Prepare PenStrep dilution series 0 / 15 / 25 % v/v in LB
GATE: G1: hand off aqueous reagents to the external agar caster (human / other robot)
G2: operator measures + enters culture OD600 (runtime parameter)
OFF_DECK: mix agar + PenStrep 50:50 and cast the partial-solidification gradient
add diluted culture to the plate

open_clarifications: concentration basis: 15/25 % v/v of 10,000 U/mL stock vs the abstract's 1500/2500/10000 U/mL framing
assay plate: paper text says 12-well, abstract says 24-well (Fig 1 shows 2 wells)
